context: Three women at the café planning a girls' trip to Okinawa. Excitement and logistics tangle together.
purpose: friend-group trip planning — three female voices coordinating around shared anticipation

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: いよいよ旅行の話、進めよう！
lines.en: Finally, let's move the trip plans forward!
lines.style: Office woman bright energetic gathering, the eager planning-mode audible, soft real warmth threading throughout delivery throughout.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん、私もずっと楽しみにしてた。

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 沖縄、初めてだから、すごく嬉しい。

lines.style: Dreamy artist warm soft excitement, the gentle real anticipation audible, soft real warmth threading throughout delivery throughout.

lines.speaker: yuki_office

lines.jp: 何月にする？私、五月が休み取りやすい。

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: よし、五月で決まり！ホテルは？

lines.speaker: aoi_barista

lines.speaker: mei_romantic

lines.speaker: yuki_office

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
